title: Design: A/R Detail and Collection headings are in Title Case
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, so the Location column shows.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Open the design pictures "Links only where they can open" (ar-ap-p5-links-only-where-they-can-open.png) and "Expand all from the header" (ar-ap-p3-expand-all-from-the-header.png) (attached to this case) beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
custom_steps:
1. Read the column headings, letter for letter, capitals included.
  2. Open A/R Collection from the Reports menu.
  3. Read its column headings, letter for letter, capitals included.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Date", "Location", "Transaction Type", "ID", "Customer Full Name", "Due Date", "Amount", "Open Balance": every word starts with a capital letter, as in the picture and as on the A/P reports.

Step 2:

  • A/R Collection opens.

Step 3:

  • "Date", "Location", "Transaction Type", "ID", "Due Date", "Past Due", "Amount", "Open Balance", as in the picture.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R4a: “Column headings are in Title Case on all six reports, on screen, in the PDF and in the CSV, as on the other reports (Sales By Customer, Inventory Value, Parts Velocity): the A/R reports read "Transaction Type", "Customer Full Name", "Due Date", "Past Due" and "Open Balance", the same as the A/P reports.”
  • S2-R1, A/R Detail columns: “A/R Detail: Date, Location (when shown), Transaction Type, ID, Customer Full Name, Due Date, Amount, Open Balance.”
  • S2-R1, A/R Collection columns: “A/R Collection: Date, Location (when shown), Transaction Type, ID, Due Date, Past Due, Amount, Open Balance.”
  • What changes for existing users: “The A/R column headings change to Title Case, as on the A/P reports and the other reports: "Transaction Type", "Customer Full Name", "Due Date", "Past Due", "Open Balance".”
  • Out of Scope: “Renaming columns other than Location. Only the capitals change (S2-R4a): A/R keeps "ID" and "Customer Full Name", A/P keeps "No." and "Vendor Name".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 3 "Collapse all and pinned group rows" (board Grouped.dc.html); page 5 "Document links and Switch location" (board Links.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p5-links-only-where-they-can-open.png: figure "Links only where they can open" (This build (after)), board "5. Document links and Switch location (SV-5706)"
  • ar-ap-p3-expand-all-from-the-header.png: figure "Expand all from the header" (This build (after)), board "3. Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows"

The design's own words:

  • "A number links only with the right permission and a location the user works at; otherwise plain text. Native link style. S7-R1, S7-R2, S7-R6, S7-R7, S7-N1, S7-N2." (caption of "Links only where they can open")
  • "One chevron in the top-left header cell: "Collapse all" while any group is open, "Expand all" when none is. Group toggles use the same chevron. S4-R1 to S4-R5, S4-R8." (caption of "Expand all from the header")

Difference from the PRD (DD-06), closed: PRD version 5 said A/R Detail and A/R Collection headings written "Transaction type", "Customer full name", "Due date", "Past due", "Open balance" (S2-R1); the design shows the after pictures read "Transaction Type", "Customer Full Name", "Due Date", "Past Due", "Open Balance"; today's production pictures already read the same, with "Location Full Name". Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 4): Title Case on all six reports, on screen, in the PDF and in the CSV, as the design shows; PRD version 9 adds S2-R4a and writes S2-R1 in Title Case. The design's version is now the requirement and this case follows PRD version 9; D-81 (C715563), held until then, is now a normal design case.
